# iru_device_settings (Resource)

Manages Blueprint, user, asset-tag and tag settings of an existing enrolled device through GET/PATCH. Omitted settings are observed but not written. Import by device UUID. Destroy releases management and retains the device and its settings; enrollment, erasure, deletion and commands are never performed.

This resource adopts an already enrolled device. Omitted fields are observed but excluded from PATCH. An explicit empty user_id or asset_tag sends JSON null; tags = [] clears the tag list. Blueprint assignment requires a UUID; Blueprint clearing is not invented. Changing device_id releases the old mapping and adopts the new existing record. Destroy does not erase, unenroll, delete, or reset either device. Match existing configured values for a no-change import plan.

A successful PATCH is followed by GET and configured-value verification. Permission/read errors retain prior state, and ambiguous writes are not replayed. A verified 404 removes the settings mapping from state but cannot re-enroll or recreate a missing device.

## Example Usage


```terraform
resource "iru_device_settings" "example" {
  device_id = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
  asset_tag = "Managed with Terraform"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Existing enrolled or ADE-device record UUID, according to resource type. Changing it releases the old settings and adopts the new record.

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) Asset tag. Omit to leave unmanaged. For enrolled devices only, an empty string explicitly clears it.
- `blueprint_id` (String) Assigned Blueprint UUID. Omit to observe without managing it.
- `tags` (Set of String) Assigned tag names. Omit to leave unmanaged; an explicit empty set clears all tags.
- `user_id` (String) Assigned directory-user UUID. Omit to leave unmanaged. For enrolled devices only, an empty string explicitly clears assignment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Existing device UUID. This resource does not create a device record.

## Import


```shell
terraform import iru_device_settings.example 11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555
```


Contract: [official Iru API](https://api-docs.iru.com/). Mock tests are not live tenant acceptance.
